origin.description: The closing sequence of a style, from the last combined style back to the first.
origin.details: Dispatches on the class. The crayon method reverses the close codes. An empty string is returned when color is off.

translation.description: The closing sequence of a style, from the last combined style back to the first.
translation.details: The close code of each combined style, last style first.
translation.value: The closing sequence, or an empty string when color is off.
